_comment: Holdout recall questions for scripts/bench.py, written against corpus.json before any step 5 ranking change. Reported next to the main set, never used to tune it. Same format as questions.json: every question is a 'paraphrase' that shares no content word with its gold memory (the harness verifies this); 'weak' queries have no gold and are expected to return zero hits. Kinds covered: decision, gotcha, rule, procedure, fact.

questions.query: how are people signing in on the website and kicked out immediately
how do we keep users uninterrupted while machines are swapped sequentially
what tool prints our billing documents
newly minted links get denied because one machine's watch was ahead
program refuses to launch on my newer notebook computer
where may passwords and keys live in our repo
anonymous URLs must state how much traffic they tolerate
swapping the access phrase for our datastore with no outage
how long are purchase histories stored
which release of our data store software is deployed

weak_queries.query: knitting pattern for a wool scarf
